input.headline: Reliance posts record quarterly profit, beats analyst estimates
input.body: Reliance Industries reported a record quarterly profit, with revenue up 18% year-over-year, beating Street estimates by a wide margin.

input.headline: TCS narrowly misses revenue guidance amid macro headwinds
input.body: Tata Consultancy Services' revenue grew 4% in constant currency, narrowly missing its own guidance, citing weak BFSI spending in North America.

input.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 6.50%
input.body: The Reserve Bank of India's MPC voted 5-1 to hold the policy repo rate steady, citing balanced risks to inflation and growth.

input.headline: Adani Group shares slump as Hindenburg releases short-seller report
input.body: Shares of Adani-listed companies fell 5-15% after a US-based short-seller alleged accounting irregularities and stock manipulation.

input.headline: Infosys raises FY guidance after strong Q2
input.body: Infosys lifted its FY revenue growth guidance to 4.5-5%, up from 1-3.5%, after a stronger-than-expected second quarter driven by financial-services deal wins.

input.headline: HDFC Bank merger completes; combined entity becomes 4th-largest globally
input.body: The HDFC-HDFC Bank merger has officially closed. The combined entity is now the world's fourth-largest bank by market capitalization.

input.headline: ICICI Bank reports asset-quality stress in unsecured retail book
input.body: ICICI Bank flagged rising delinquencies in its personal-loan and credit-card portfolio, with 30+ DPD trending up over three quarters.

input.headline: SEBI tightens disclosure norms for FPIs
input.body: The Securities and Exchange Board of India tightened beneficial-ownership disclosure requirements for foreign portfolio investors holding concentrated positions.

input.headline: Wipro CFO resigns abruptly, citing personal reasons
input.body: Wipro's chief financial officer resigned with immediate effect, the company said in a regulatory filing, without naming a successor.

input.headline: Bajaj Finance launches new EMI product targeting tier-2 cities
input.body: Bajaj Finance unveiled a no-cost EMI product aimed at tier-2 and tier-3 retail customers, expanding its addressable market by an estimated 40%.

input.headline: Q2 GDP growth comes in at 7.6%, beats consensus of 6.8%
input.body: India's Q2 GDP grew 7.6% year-over-year, beating consensus expectations of 6.8%, led by manufacturing and government spending.

input.headline: Jet fuel prices rise 5% on supply concerns
input.body: Aviation turbine fuel prices rose 5% month-over-month, putting pressure on margins for IndiGo, SpiceJet, and Air India.

input.headline: Tata Motors announces ₹15,000 crore EV investment over 5 years
input.body: Tata Motors will invest ₹15,000 crore over five years to expand its electric vehicle portfolio and build domestic battery manufacturing.

input.headline: INR weakens past 84 per USD on FII outflows
input.body: The Indian rupee weakened past 84 per US dollar for the first time, pressured by sustained foreign-institutional-investor outflows from equities.

input.headline: Paytm shares hit lower circuit on RBI lending curbs
input.body: Paytm shares hit the 20% lower circuit after the RBI directed Paytm Payments Bank to halt new deposits and credit transactions.

input.headline: Maruti reports flat October dispatches
input.body: Maruti Suzuki India's October vehicle dispatches were flat at 184,000 units, broadly in line with expectations as festive demand normalised.

input.headline: Sun Pharma USFDA inspection ends with zero observations
input.body: Sun Pharmaceutical's Halol facility inspection by the US FDA concluded with zero Form 483 observations, a clean outcome.

input.headline: L&T wins ₹40,000 crore defence order
input.body: Larsen & Toubro secured a ₹40,000 crore order from the Ministry of Defence for advanced weapon systems, the largest single defence order in its history.

input.headline: Indian railways announces fare hike for AC classes
input.body: Indian Railways announced a 10-15% fare hike for AC classes, effective next month, the first revision in three years.

input.headline: Vedanta delays demerger; bondholders flag refinancing risk
input.body: Vedanta Resources delayed its planned demerger by six months. Bondholders raised concerns over upcoming USD 3.2 bn debt maturities.
